response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Forclaz Trek 900 head torch, and key claims like lumens and USB rechargeability are supported by the photos. Hidden risks exist regarding functionality and condition, but the item can be priced at its worst case (non-working or non-rechargeable) until proven otherwise.
